Mumbai Airport Terminal 1 Redevelopment to Affect Minimal International Traffic

The redevelopment of Mumbai Airport's Terminal 1, originally commissioned in 1964, is underway to address structural and safety concerns. Approximately 91% of the airport's international traffic will remain unaffected by the project, with 39 out of 50 international airlines continuing their operations at the airport during the revamp.
